name: Show
purpose: Show content only at selected Brick breakpoints through CSS, avoiding JavaScript viewport state and hydration flicker.
useWhen: A complete region should appear only at selected Brick breakpoints.

avoidWhen.condition: Content must remain available to assistive technology while visually hidden, or rendering depends on authorization or data.

composition: Wrap the smallest complete composition whose responsive presence changes; combine with Hide only for intentional alternate desktop/mobile structures.

rules.statement: Use Show's CSS breakpoint contract rather than client viewport detection for responsive first paint.
Keep IDs, landmarks, form relationships, and focus order valid in every visible alternative.
Rely on Show's layout-transparent visible state inside parent layouts and put paint or geometry on a child layout component.
Omit default-valued props such as as=div; use as only for deliberate HTML semantics or valid document structure.
Load styles.css or core.css plus show.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Adding application CSS to repair Show spacing or writing as=div even though div is the default.
commonMistakes.correction: Rely on Show's layout-transparent default and specify as only when semantics require another host.

commonMistakes.mistake: Forgetting show.css or rendering duplicate visible navigation because Show and Hide use the wrong thresholds.
commonMistakes.correction: Load the modular CSS and verify exact breakpoint boundaries.

validation: Test boundary pixels, zoom, first paint, hydration, focus order, landmarks, and duplicate IDs.
